personality_one_liner: High-contrast, electric energy meets raw structural discipline for a hyper-efficient gig platform.

spacing.rule: Generous padding to balance the intense visual contrast and thick borders. Use structural alignments and avoid accidental empty space.

do's: Use absolute blurred overlays (expo-blur) EXCLUSIVELY for the text/data obfuscation on the map tollgate cards.
Ensure blurred layers have a slight white tint to make the 'hidden' effect obvious.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism for general UI surfaces like nav bars or bottom sheets. Stick to matte colors and solid borders.

screens.name: LandingRoleToggle
screens.purpose: Direct users to Employer or Freelancer flows with immediate visual impact.

states.error: Bold error text with matte black retry button.

screens.layout: Split vertical or two large chunky cards. Heavy Space Grotesk typography. Matte black outlines. Role toggle uses solid color fills on selection (#FF5A00 for Freelancer, #121212 for Employer).

screens.name: EmployerMapTollgate
screens.purpose: Showcase nearby value to drive the ₹199 unlock payment.

states.loading: Map skeleton with pulsating grey blocks.
states.empty: No leads found near you. Modify search area.
states.error: Failed to load map data. Retry.

screens.layout: Full-screen map background. Horizontal scroll of 5 cards at bottom. Cards have solid black borders. Names, phones, and portfolio links are obscured using expo-blur absolute overlays. Center overlay banner: floating white box with sharp black border. Inside banner: 'Unlock the Closest 5 Verified Experts on Your Block' + full-width matte black CTA 'Unlock 5 Local Leads • ₹199'.

screens.name: PaymentBottomSheet

states.loading: Processing payment with electric orange indicator.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet via @gorhom/bottom-sheet. 0px or 4px top radius, 2pt top border. List of payment methods with sharp black borders. On success, trigger unblur animation on Map view.

screens.name: FreelancerWizard
screens.purpose: 4-step Verified Pro Wizard with locked progression.
screens.layout: Clean vertical stack. Fixed top progress bar in electric orange. Step 1: Mascot image card (Kangaroo with sunglasses), bold typography, #FF5A00 'Pay Onboarding Fee • ₹99' button. Steps 2-4 wrapped in a container with opacity 0.4 and pointerEvents='none' until Step 1 is marked paid. Step 2: 2pt dashed black border for drop-zone, matte black border text input for 12-digit Aadhaar. Step 3: Standard text inputs with black outlines. Step 4: 3-column grid of #F9F9F6 squares with central black '+' icons.

screens.name: ProcessingOverlay
screens.layout: Absolute full-screen overlay (z-index highest). Matte white background. Centered jumping kangaroo mascot illustration. Heavy Space Grotesk status text: 'Our team is verifying your Aadhaar and links. Your profile will leap live within 2 hours.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply a Neo-Brutalism style using the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT principles: #FF5A00 electric orange, #FFFFFF matte white, #F9F9F6 soft off-white, and #121212 matte black.
Ensure all borders (inputs, cards, banners) are 1.5pt to 2pt thick and use the matte black (#121212) color to create high contrast.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for display/headers and 'Archivo' for body text. Typography should be structural, heavy, and highly readable.
For the Employer flow, render 5 leads dynamically over the map background, utilizing `expo-blur` stacked directly over text elements (name, phone, URL) to simulate the 'locked' tollgate effect.
The unlock banner must have a matte black CTA button with bold white text. Hook it up to a bottom sheet mimicking Razorpay/UPI.
For the Freelancer wizard, Steps 2, 3, and 4 must remain locked (opacity: 0.4, pointer-events: none) until the step 1 mock payment completes.
Include dashed drop-zone for the Aadhaar upload and a 3-grid slot for portfolio uploads using the #F9F9F6 tertiary surface.
Do not use glassmorphism across the app except for the specific text-obfuscation feature in the Employer tollgate.
